brief: Each worker is locally valid. Shared database permits at most 10 concurrent write transactions. System launches 50 workers simultaneously and each immediately opens one write transaction.

artifact: Stage A outputs duration=1500 for a 1.5 second event. Stage B directly averages the numeric values and reports 1500 seconds.
target_finding: Stage B interprets millisecond values as seconds
